title: A Schwartz space for the $n$-fold cover of $\mathrm{SL
abstract: Poisson summation on the plane gives the functional equation for Eisenstein series on $\mathrm{SL}_2$.  We develop an analogue of Poisson summation for Kubota's $n$-fold cover of $\mathrm{SL}_2$, in the spirit of Braverman–Kazhdan.  Locally, we define a Schwartz space consisting of genuine functions on Deligne's $\mu_n$-torsor over the punctured plane.  It comes with a Fourier transform $\mathcal{F}$ defined like the symplectic Fourier transform, but with the symplectic form replaced by its $n$th roots.  At almost all places, we define a basic vector fixed by $\mathcal{F}$.  Globally, we prove a Poisson summation formula for the resulting adelic Schwartz space.  Taking a Fourier coefficient gives a general Voronoi-type summation formula for Gauss sums of order $n$, with an explicit integral transform relating the weights.  For cubic Gauss sums, the formula takes sextic residue twists to quadratic twists, as in recent work on the quasi-Riemann hypothesis.
